purpose: Provide explicit public behavioral supervision for the full-envelope fabric so structural support, endpoint roles, causal evidence use, irrelevant-view invariance, uncertainty/defer, public judgment, and permutation behavior are trained rather than inferred from narrow semantic gates.
required_structural_targets: support edge set or explicit null support
required_causal_variants: decisive evidence removal when a decisive source exists
irrelevant evidence removal when an irrelevant source exists
field permutation with exact edge and target reindexing

split_isolation.relation_family_holdout_authority: natural FewRel and semantic-operator intervention lanes
split_isolation.reason: The behavioral lane isolates structural/causal templates and entities while separate natural/operator lanes own relation-family extrapolation. Requiring every relation family to be held out in every lane would remove needed structural training rather than improve leakage control.

target_semantics.support_target: binary query-relevant structural/semantic edge support target over the primary runtime edge bank before step-local reliability/recency/temporal/provenance arbitration; same-relation query-irrelevant edges remain negatives; rows with no support use all-zero target plus Binder null-support supervision
target_semantics.endpoint_target: semantic source and semantic target field indices for supported relational execution; inactive rows use -1 with endpoint_active=false
target_semantics.decisive_view_active: true only when the row supplies a governed decisive evidence removal intervention
target_semantics.irrelevant_view_active: true only when the row supplies a governed irrelevant evidence removal intervention
target_semantics.recoverable_view_mask: labels behaviorally relevant or explicitly information-preserving views; availability alone is not relevance
target_semantics.public_judgment_target: index of a semantic answer candidate, never an opaque class ID; matched context-swap rows keep query and candidate set/order fixed while governing evidence changes which candidate is correct
target_semantics.counterfactual_target: valid alternate semantic candidate when available; -1 when no meaningful counterfactual exists

materialization.role: behavioral and causal full-envelope supplement mixed with broad semantic replay, governed judgment replay, natural relation data, and semantic-operator interventions
